packageRules.description: wincode 0.5 is incompatible with serde-wincode 0.1.0 which still depends on wincode ^0.4. Hold the auto-bump until serde-wincode publishes a 0.5-compatible release.

DataFusion is a deliberate apache/datafusion `main` git pin (tracks arrow 59 / parquet 59 / object_store 0.13 compatibility) that is bumped intentionally, not on every upstream commit. Without a limit, renovate opens a fresh digest PR per DataFusion `main` commit, which constantly conflicts with in-flight branches that carry the `version` pin on the same line. Rate-limit it to a monthly PR for a commit that is at least 30 days old.
schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: object_store, parquet and arrow are coupled satellites of the datafusion git pin: that revision requires object_store ^0.13 / parquet 59 / arrow 59, and crabka-blockstore passes their types across the ParquetObjectReader / register_object_store boundary. Bumping any of them on its own splits the dependency graph and fails to compile (the auto-merged object_store 0.14 bump #644 broke main exactly this way). Disable independent auto-bumps; they move only when the datafusion rev is bumped intentionally.
